image_description: A side-profile view of a bison standing on a grassy, dirt-covered slope. The bison faces right, displaying its characteristic shoulder hump, shaggy dark brown fur on the forequarters, and a large head with a visible horn. The background consists of green vegetation and a sandy hill.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile, showing a broad structure and a single visible horn that appears short and curved relative to the head size.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct mass of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, consistent with a bison's beard.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, though partially obscured by fur, it matches the description.
No prominent ears are sticking out; the area where ears would be is covered by the thick fur of the head, consistent with them being hidden.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits a massive build with a high shoulder hump, typical of bison anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur, creating the distinctive hump shape.
The visible portion of the hindquarters shows shorter, smoother fur compared to the dense mane on the shoulders.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible horn is relatively small and short in proportion to the massive head and body.
The legs are cut off by the bottom edge of the image frame; hooves are not visible.
The rear of the bison is either out of frame or obscured by the angle; the tail is not visible.

To verify the structural integrity of the visible limbs and spine alignment, despite the crop.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the fur and background blending that might indicate AI generation.

focus_areas: Fur texture consistency (shaggy vs smooth transition)
Anatomical plausibility of the shoulder hump
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the dark fur of the bison and the green background. AI models often struggle with fine, irregular edges like shaggy fur against complex textures. Verify if the horn looks naturally attached or if it appears 'pasted' on. Check if the lighting on the fur matches the ambient light of the scene.
